end.summary:
Defined food miles as the total distance food travels from farm to home.
Added journey sections correctly, including farm-to-shop and shop-to-home distances.
Compared distance travelled with fuel use, pollution, freshness, packaging and refrigeration.
Suggested seasonal local food, combined deliveries and a school kitchen garden.
Discussed limits: local seasonal food may not be available all year; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Rohan practised adding all parts of a food journey and linking longer distances with more fuel, pollution, packaging and possible freshness effects. They explained the calculations clearly and suggested seasonal local produce, combined deliveries and a school kitchen garden. They initially linked distant food with being more nutritious or having better taste; this was not fully corrected in the lesson. At home, ask them to trace one food item from farm to home and add each journey section.

Haan, dukaan wale se poochhkar ya packet padhkar khaane ka srot pata chal sakta hai. Dahi par jahaan bana hai, woh jagah bhi ek suraag hai. Agar chai ke packet par Assam likha ho aur aap Jaipur mein hon, toh us chai ka safar chhota hoga ya lamba? Kyon?
zyada hoga na? assam bahut door hai jaipur se. mummy kehti hai assam ki chai bahut famous hai aur special hoti hai, door se aane se shayad uska taste bhi accha ho jaata hai.

Assam Jaipur se door hai, isliye chai ka safar lamba ho sakta hai. Assam ki chai ka swaad achha ho sakta hai, par door ka safar apne aap swaad nahin badhata. Ab aloo Punjab se packing ke liye 220 kilometer, phir dukaan tak 90 kilometer gaya. Uska poora safar kitna hua?
poora safar... 220 plus 90... ek second... ye dono jodna hai kya? to 310 km hua na.
Haan, dono hisse jodne hain: Punjab se Haryana, phir dukaan tak. Aapne 310 kilometer nikala. Aloo ke safar mein packing se pehle wale 220 kilometer bhi kyon ginenge?
kyunki aloo punjab mein uga hai na? to wahan se packing tak ka safar bhi to kiya, truck mein aaya hoga. packing ke baad hi to nahi ugaya tha, khhet se nikla hai.
Haan, aloo khet se packing tak bhi gaya tha. Isliye us safar ko bhi ginte hain. Jab khaana bahut door se aata hai, toh kaun si do dikkat ho sakti hain?
